decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed two-storey side extension, by reason of its position, disproportionate width, and staggered design, would fail to be secondary to the proportions of the original house, would harm the distinctive character of the house, and would represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature within the street scene, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - The proposed two-storey side extension would result in the loss of the existing garage and the applicant has failed to demonstrate that off-street parking could be adequately provided on site in the interests of pedestrian and highway safety, contrary to adopted Unitary Development Plan policy T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments).
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to house.
